title.narrative: Deep Decarbonisation Innovation for Steel and Cement Industries (DDI)

description.narrative: The steel, metals, and cement sectors in Brazil are responsible for approximately 75% of the country’s greenhouse gas emissions from industrial processes. This project aims to create the enabling conditions for Brazil’s steel and cement industries to invest in decarbonisation solutions. It will support the government in driving industrial transformation by strengthening its capacity to develop public policies, foster breakthrough technology development, and build the technical expertise companies need to implement low-carbon production methods. It will prove the viability of decarbonisation demonstration plants and unlock significant public and private investments by structuring targeted financial instruments and activating demand for green steel and cement among key offtakers. The project will also deepen supply chain integration between Brazil and Germany/EU in in both sectors and embed diversity and gender equality across all decarbonisation activities.
